The '''2018 Minnesota State Championship''' was held on 15 July 2018, the second day of the Bespin Super Weekend, organized by [[Mark Walseth]].<ref name="mn18sheet">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1202007#p1202007 Bespin Super Weekend - July 14th / 15th], Walsetmd, Players Committee forum (16 July 2018). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122224900/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1202007.html Internet Archive]</ref> Charlie A won the final confrontation and is the champion, and Bryan M was the only undefeated player after six rounds.<ref name="mn18champ">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1202005#p1202005 Bespin Super Weekend - July 14th / 15th], Walsetmd, Players Committee forum (16 July 2018). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122224900/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1202007.html Internet Archive]</ref>
